title: Default test run at lmwqozysyszl
description: The default test run (python3 lib/tools/test_costs.py run: cargo test and every Python suite, the unit and tool tiers) at change lmwqozysyszl, "What a default run left unread is a plain output file of the job, and its log says only how many paths", queued the first to write its unread list as an output file. Nobody waits for it: the watcher or the next session reads the result, and sync.py push requires a passed run that covers the commit it pushes (verification/default_tests.py).
expected: exits 0: every test of the default run passes

resources.notes: as a job on six CPUs the run took 19.5 minutes one test file after another, 14.5 with Rust beside Python and 8.6 with the Rust binaries and Python files several at a time (2026-11-17), longer beside proof jobs; its cargo target directory is kept warm between runs
